text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I see... Just as the rumors say, things 
really don't go smoothly, do they?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...With every play, she showed clear 
improvement.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
People grow. Slowly, but surely. Next time 
will definitely go well.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: So there is no need to feel down. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The fact that you tried so desperately for 
me. That made me happier than anything 
else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
